mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id FROM map_user m JOIN iuser u ON u.user_id = m.user_id WHERE m.inst_code = #{instCode} AND m.legacy_user_id = #{legacyUserId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM iuser WHERE user_id = #{userId})
SELECT m.project_no FROM map_project m JOIN project p ON p.project_no = m.project_no WHERE m.inst_code = #{instCode} AND m.legacy_research_no = #{legacyResearchNo} AND NOT m.is_virtual
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project WHERE project_no = #{projectNo})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mig_virtual_project_rule WHERE inst_code = #{instCode} AND legacy_regno = #{legacyRegno})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO map_project (inst_code, legacy_research_no, project_no, is_virtual, migration_run_id) VALUES (#{instCode}, '__VIRTUAL__', fn_virtual_project_no(#{instCode}), true, #{runId}) ON CONFLICT (inst_code, legacy_research_no) DO NOTHING
